lead.headline: No claim before 01:00, and two receivers return on a label
lead.deck: ESPN moved Jefferson and McLaurin from OUT to QUESTIONABLE today with no report behind it. They go back in with fallbacks. The waiver run passes without you.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players: nothing was reported on Tuesday about Justin Jefferson's ankle or Terry McLaurin's hamstring. What changed is ESPN's label. Both were OUT this morning and are QUESTIONABLE this afternoon, and the lineup check now starts both. Jefferson's coach still has 'no real projection' and mentioned the Week 6 bye; McLaurin's still promises 'a better update for Wednesday'. Neither has practised since he was hurt. The projection lineup is the rule, so set it: Jefferson for Jordan Addison at 18.6 against 11.4, and McLaurin for Alvin Kamara in the flex at 13.2 against 11.2. All four play at 11:00 on Sunday, so the benched man in each pair is the fallback and nothing locks early. Check the inactive lists at 09:30. Waivers process at 01:00 tonight and this is the last brief before they do. There is no claim. You are first in the order and DK Metcalf would come to you, but every seat he could take is closed: Jalen Coker is expected back for Week 6, when Minnesota and Miami are off, and Addison's seat is five days old and is Jefferson's fallback. Thursday is different. If Jefferson has practised by then and Metcalf went unclaimed, he is a free agent and Addison's seat is open. The biggest riser on the wire, Joe Mixon, lost his reason today: Seattle declined to sign him after his physical. ESPN has you at 49% against Los Gigantes de Teca, whose best player, Ja'Marr Chase, is in the concussion protocol.

rows.reason: Bigsby is on injured reserve and Barkley is 'likely out' for London (Inquirer, 6 Oct), so he is Philadelphia's only healthy back and ESPN now projects 10.3. 6 carries for 23 last week and 15 all season; three practice-squad backs may be elevated. Below all five of your backs.
rows.falsifiedIf: Barkley is ruled out for a month and one of your own backs is ruled out with him.

rows.name: Keaton Mitchell
rows.reason: A three-man rotation by design: snaps 26, 25, 25 with Omarion Hampton healthy, and Jim Harbaugh says it 'is best for our team' (Last Word on Sports, 5 Oct). 15 touches for 63. The Chargers are off in Week 7.

rows.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rows.reason: Bijan Robinson is healthy: 19 carries for 145. Brian Robinson's three touchdowns, from 4, 8 and 11 yards, came mostly in the second half of a 45–24 win (CBS, 6 Oct). Double-digit carries three weeks running, but a handcuff.

rows.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rows.reason: Ashton Jeanty's handcuff: 10 touches for 17 yards while Jeanty had 21 touches (CBS, 4 Oct). Nothing changed.

rows.name: Tyler Allgeier
rows.reason: He out-snapped Jeremiyah Love 36 to 30 while Arizona manage Love's ankle; Love says it is 'not really bothering me' (Yahoo, 6 Oct). 8 carries for 42 and a touchdown. A sixth back here.
rows.falsifiedIf: Love is held out of Wednesday's and Thursday's practice.

rows.name: Makai Lemon
rows.reason: DeVonta Smith is expected to miss multiple games (Inquirer). Lemon had a career-high 6 targets for 27 yards and has 30 or fewer in every game; Darius Cooper played more snaps and caught both touchdowns.
rows.falsifiedIf: Eight or more targets in London.

rows.name: Malik Washington
rows.reason: Target shares of 28% and 29% and 86% of the snaps (Yahoo, 5 Oct), in an offence that threw for 85 yards and scored 10. Off in Week 6 with your Vikings.
rows.falsifiedIf: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a new quarterback in Miami.

rows.name: Isaiah Williams
rows.reason: The screen's efficiency flag is right: 2 catches for 73, one a 58-yard touchdown late in a decided game, on 15 team attempts. FantasyPros calls him 'Fool's Gold'. He is the Jets' second receiver only while Adonai Mitchell is out.
rows.falsifiedIf: Six or more targets against Cleveland.

rows.name: Antonio Williams
rows.reason: 8 targets with McLaurin inactive and 21 yards from them, plus an 85-yard touchdown wiped out by penalty (Fantasy Six Pack, 6 Oct). The role depends on your own McLaurin staying out.
rows.falsifiedIf: McLaurin is ruled out for multiple weeks and Williams draws eight targets again from Daniels.

rows.name: Romeo Doubs
rows.reason: 9 targets and two touchdowns against Buffalo after Mack Hollins left hurt. A.J. Brown, now a Patriot, is eligible to come off injured reserve in Week 6 and is 'pushing hard to be back ASAP' (Pelissero).
rows.falsifiedIf: Brown returns and Doubs's targets fall back to four.

rows.name: T.J. Hockenson
rows.reason: 13 catches on 13 targets with Jefferson out; NFL.com calls it 'likely an aberration'. A tight end has no route into this lineup behind Likely. Minnesota are off in Week 6.
rows.falsifiedIf: Likely on a Giants injury report.

rows.name: Brenton Strange
rows.reason: 7 catches on 8 targets for 95, a career high on 87% of the snaps, after 7 catches in the three games before (PlayerProfiler). No coach has explained it. No second tight-end slot here.
rows.falsifiedIf: Likely on a Giants injury report.

rows.name: Oronde Gadsden
rows.reason: David Njoku and Charlie Kolar are on injured reserve, which is the role (Yahoo, 5 Oct); Yahoo calls him a 'dart throw'. His Week 4 line was not retrieved. Not on the published wire.
rows.falsifiedIf: Likely on a Giants injury report.

rows.name: Tyler Higbee
rows.reason: Terrance Ferguson is on injured reserve and Colby Parkinson was absent: 17 targets in two weeks, 5 of 6 for 67 last week (RotoWire; ClutchPoints, 6 Oct). Injury-driven volume at a position you can't use twice.
rows.falsifiedIf: Likely on a Giants injury report.

rows.name: Tucker Kraft
rows.reason: 6 of 7 targets for 42 and his first touchdown, a season high as he comes back from an ACL tear (FantasyPros, 5 Oct). 10.5 against Likely's 12.9, and no flex route for a tight end in Chem.
rows.falsifiedIf: Likely on a Giants injury report.

rows.name: Kirk Cousins
rows.reason: 31 of 52 for 365 in a 30–27 loss; 11 touchdown passes, tied for the league lead, and three straight 20-point games (SI, 4 Oct). You start one quarterback and he is Josh Allen.
rows.falsifiedIf: Allen on a Bills injury report.

rows.name: Tyson Bagent
rows.reason: Confirmed as Chicago's starter at Green Bay (Ben Johnson, 5 Oct); Caleb Williams won't practise this week. 268 yards and no touchdowns last week. A short-term starter behind Allen.
rows.falsifiedIf: Allen on a Bills injury report.

rows.name: Jalon Daniels
rows.reason: An undrafted rookie starting on Thursday at Dallas while Baker Mayfield's dislocated thumb heals, 'at least three weeks' (Bowles). 148 yards and two interceptions in his first start.
rows.falsifiedIf: Allen on a Bills injury report.

cannotSee.label: Why ESPN changed two labels
cannotSee.body: Jefferson and McLaurin went from OUT to QUESTIONABLE between the 12:49 and 21:49 UTC snapshots. ESPN's pages returned empty and no outlet reported anything on Tuesday. Both cards treat the change as a label reset, which is an inference.

cannotSee.label: Wednesday's practice reports
cannotSee.body: The first Week 5 participation reports for Minnesota, Washington, Chicago and Pittsburgh come on Wednesday afternoon, about fourteen hours after claims process. Buffalo's first is Thursday.

cannotSee.label: Rival claims
cannotSee.body: ESPN returns only your own, and the league file carries none. You are first of ten in this week's order. Everyone on the wire is on waivers until Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City; I can't see whether anyone has put in for Metcalf.

cannotSee.label: Intraday projection moves
cannotSee.body: Kamara went from 10.0 to 11.2 and Gordon from 11.0 to 10.9 between this morning's file and this one. I found no news that explains either. That flipped a coin flip, and it may flip back.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: Tiles now use FootballDB's full-PPR table, four games deep. Standard and PPR ranks differ by at most five places for your players. RotoWire's description of Cleveland's corners contradicts the points-allowed rank for Garrett Wilson; I have shown the rank and said so.

cannotSee.label: Snap counts I couldn't re-confirm
cannotSee.body: This morning's 28-snap split for Kamara and CJ Donaldson, and the 36-to-15 split for Tuten and Rodriguez, each rest on one page this afternoon's research could not verify.

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: Keaton Mitchell, Isaiah Williams, Antonio Williams, Oronde Gadsden and Tyler Higbee aren't on the published wire, so their availability in this league is the screen's inference that nobody rosters them.

cannotSee.label: Reports I couldn't retrieve
cannotSee.body: ESPN's article, injury and depth-chart pages returned empty, so I can't see why its labels on Jefferson and McLaurin changed. Star Tribune, Hogs Haven, Bleeding Green Nation, Stampede Blue, Arrowhead Pride, Field Gulls and Pro Football Rumors were blocked; RotoBaller and several NBC Sports pages gave no article body; FantasyPros' tables did not render. Kellen Moore, Kevin O'Connell, Dan Quinn and Jeff Hafley said nothing on Tuesday that I could find; the newest coach comments are Monday's. Pages were read through a summarising tool, so quotes are close but may not be exact.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Three receivers have unknown timelines, and anything offered would be priced on guesses. The window the strategy names is Weeks 9 to 11.

cannotSee.label: Next week
cannotSee.body: Minnesota and Miami are both off in Week 6: Jefferson, Addison, the Vikings' defence and Gordon. That is next Tuesday's problem and the main reason Coker's return and Thursday's look at Metcalf matter.
